text: Owner correction 2026-07-28: when a file needs the owner's review, the FIRST mention must be an absolute path (starting with / or ~), never repo-relative or a basename. The owner had to ask 'where can I find the spec' after a reply cited .claude/output/20260728-run-page-spec/experience-spec.md relative. Same class as the standing 'don't cite basenames' rule; the miss survives because checkpoint/doc citations are habitually repo-relative and get pasted into owner-facing replies unexpanded. Insight: expand paths at the reader boundary - internal docs may stay relative, but any owner-facing mention crosses an audience boundary and must resolve to absolute at that crossing.
